summary: The native predicate change is source-consistent with the original zero-mass and half-open-CDF contract, and no source-level counterexample was found. The exact candidate could not be rebuilt or executed because the assigned gfx950 ROCm environment lacks the CUDA-only AOT operator and toolchain. Therefore the candidate's native fix and DFlash/EAGLE/MTP caller paths remain unverified.

tests.what_was_measured: On the recorded base, attempted the original synthetic DFlash failure on the assigned GPU; DFlash rejected non-greedy verification as unavailable before invoking the native sampler.
At the base, both existing focused tests failed at operator lookup because the installed ROCm sgl_kernel does not register tree_speculative_sampling_target_only.
At exact candidate commit, clean native configuration failed because the project requires CUDA and nvcc was unavailable on the ROCm host.
At exact candidate commit, collected seven focused tests, including five added CDF boundary cases.

At exact candidate commit, all seven tests failed before kernel launch because the imported preinstalled ROCm extension lacks the target-only operator; this is not a candidate pass or a native validation.
The candidate contains trailing whitespace in committed raw evidence logs; no changed sampler source or regression-test whitespace error was reported.

gpu_execution_evidence: Torch identified and allocated tensors on one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), but DFlash stopped before sampler invocation and the installed native extension lacked the operator. No issue-specific kernel execution is claimed.
remaining_counterexamples: The exact candidate native library has not been built or run on a supported CUDA GPU, so the original zero-coin/zero-target-mass failure is not demonstrated passing in compiled code.
DFlash caller-path behavior remains unverified because non-greedy DFlash verification is unavailable on this ROCm build.
EAGLE and the reused MTP verification path remain unverified because the shared target-only native operator is absent.
remaining_limitations: Assigned hardware is AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 under ROCm 7.2; the changed AOT project is CUDA-only and requires nvcc/CUDAToolkit.
The prepared sgl_kernel import resolves to a preinstalled ROCm egg rather than a library built from candidate source.
No full model, model weights, semantic-accuracy workload, or distributed workload was run.
